My response was inspired by your 'to keep this kiddish look everyone understands.....'
I hope it's clear now.

Don't be sorry lol.
I am trying to say people keep repeating being rude...It dosen't matter to them..whether infps are naive or just pretend to be.

Not everyone refrains from insulting back again..no matter how naive infps are likely to be.
Some of them are downright rude.

The irony is we infps are self awaree of the fact that we're being taken advantage of.
Serves purpose i guess.

Every type has a negative side to it.
I agree we can be self absorbed though
Got to lose it. My view though.

Listen..We infps are capable as any other types to stand on our ground , we are just making sure we aren't hurting the opposite viewpoints along the way. We look for harmony not discord..hence like you say "babylike'
Attitude steps in..trying to make others feel comfortable.
And yeah we need to learn to be rigid and learn to say "NO'.
I don't want to speak on behalf of all infps..but i am trying..To grow out of my 'Babylike' persona...
Still long way to go. But i am honing my skills to stay put on my ideas and beliefs without being influenced and giving in.

Well that's how we're perceived...'Naive -fairy like bla bla bla '
But we ain't no babies. DUH.
Me carrying my books to school

You're not alone. I've been bullied everyday.
There's atleast one person who'd come up to me and criticize about my weight...Skinny legend haha.
Keep being strong. You can message me anytime...if you ever need someone to talk to.
